questions.prompt: The international pharmacopeial harmonization commission mandated that all nitrosamine testing thresholds _____ harmonized across Ph. Eur. and USP monographs.

explanations.correct: C1 chemical patent litigation & toxicological discourse: Mandative subjunctive requires base form 'be' after 'mandated that'.
explanations.wrong_A: Option 'is' violates formal mandative subjunctive or inversion rules.
explanations.wrong_C: Option 'shall be' applies indicative or non-inverted phrasing unsuited to regulatory litigation.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'must to be' is completely non-standard in international pharmacopeial jurisprudence.

questions.cz_learning_point: High-level scientific and regulatory chemistry discourse requires absolute command of mandative subjunctive ('insisted that it be performed') and inversion ('Seldom have agencies accepted').
